# Independent DEFLATE fixtures

Generated by `../compression-codec.mjs` using Node 26.7.0 and its zlib 1.2.12.
The provider under test uses zlib 1.4, not that generator's library.

The 4,096-byte input contains binary bytes and a skewed distribution. Each
wrapper has stored, fixed-Huffman and dynamic-Huffman variants. The generator
checks the raw stream's first block type is respectively 0, 1 and 2.

The checked-in corpus makes test execution independent of Node. The frozen VM
facade and the actual Nupp core provider both consume it. Core tests also
encode new streams, check empty streams and one-byte progress, and reject
truncated streams and corrupt wrapper trailers.

To regenerate, run from the repository root:

```sh
node tests/fixtures/compression-codec.mjs tests/fixtures/compression-codec
```
